answer: Duplicate identities require repeating the full stake and compute spend, so mass sybil creation drains attacker capital fast. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to its reputation slot, like freezing a unique crystal that cannot be cloned cheaply. Peers cross-check attestations through a gossip river of signed records, while honest newcomers start on a thin tundra of trust that widens only with sustained, costly participation. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
